items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: I heard little stories and everything about Bobby Jones and all the different cats that suffered under his hand

ctx.x: I’ll be darned. It could be the first time in history a straw boss played the tuba.

Right. I’m sure. I’m sure. But he was cool. I mean I heard little stories and everything about Bobby Jones and all the different cats that suffered under his hand, I watched him fire cats and before they could walk out the back door he hired them again. “Where you going? Bring your ass back here.” But he was great.
Eddie Bert was on that group?
